target_customer: People (HR) and finance teams at mid-size and large companies, mainly in Europe and the US
problem: Compensation, headcount and budgeting work is spread across systems and done by hand. Openroll gives teams an AI workspace to automate recurring work with auditable workflows.
product_category: HR tech and finance AI agents (compensation, people operations, case and contract management)

founders.name: Mattias Lindell
education: Stockholm School of Economics, MSc in Finance (left to work on Openroll)
founders.background_notes: YC page: co-led multi-billion procurement projects at Swedbank.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to HRIS and finance systems with permissions and audit trails, plus LLM agents over compensation data, is standard enterprise engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and security certifications (SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 per the company site) raise the cost of switching, but compensation tools are numerous.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Compensation platforms such as Pave, Ravio and Figures were established when Openroll joined YC in Fall 2025 (dates of the source pages not shown). Outcome of competition not yet visible.

market_need_then: The YC launch post claims early customers saw 3X ROI in week one (self-reported). The company site lists customers such as Notion, Truecaller and Mentimeter, indicating demand among tech and Nordic firms.

branding.domain_note: Uses openroll.com (company site); acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Wordmark and logo files, design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, benefit-focused, short headlines such as 'More time for your people'

brand_strength.rationale: Clean name and clear tone, but no press, community or distinctive brand asset found.

outcome_analysis: Openroll is an active four person YC Fall 2025 company with named customers on its site and no reported exit, shutdown or layoffs. The product spans compensation, case and contract management for HR teams. It is too early for an outcome, and funding is known only from aggregators.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ lists $500K pre-seed dated December 2025, Nordic 9 lists a pre-seed in January 2026 with Foundry Ventures and a Y Combinator entry, CB Insights lists $500K with Foundry Ventures, Y Combinator and Inventum Ventures. Aggregators only, so no round recorded. Competitor pages found (Pave, Ravio, Figures on G2 and CB Insights) were undated, so the list is empty. Sources disagree on location (Stockholm vs San Francisco). Outcome search found nothing on Openroll. Completeness pass: a 500K pre seed dated 2025-12 is recorded from VCBacked alone; CB Insights labels it seed and adds Foundry Ventures and Inventum Ventures as investors, so these are single database claims that differ.
